blurb:
As a Senior Full-stack Engineer at Toptal, I work on integrating and maintaining software from recently acquired companies, ensuring smooth migrations into Toptal’s platform.

I contribute across the stack using technologies like Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind, helping bring acquired products in line with Toptal’s engineering standards.

Worked closely with the CTO during a key transition from a no-code Bubble platform to a custom Express.js API for their construction estimation software. Helped define business requirements, set up project management workflows using Shortcut, and built integrations to keep systems in sync.

Also took over front-end work in React after the initial contractor phase, continuing development and maintenance.

projects.name: Estimation - API
projects.description: Developed the MVP for the Estimation API, a core back-end service for construction estimation within the Procurified platform. Led the transition from a no-code Bubble solution to a custom Node.js/Express.js implementation, focusing on scalability, maintainability, and robust data management. Responsible for designing and implementing RESTful endpoints, optimizing database interactions, and ensuring the system could support future platform growth.

projects.name: Estimation - BOQ
projects.description: Took over an initially outsourced Bill of Quantities (BOQ) application and led it to MVP launch, followed by ongoing enhancements. This standalone React app (JavaScript, CSS Modules) enables users to dynamically add or remove elements in a construction project's BOQ, efficiently rendering large datasets where performance is critical. Integrated WebSockets to provide real-time updates, ensuring all users see changes instantly and supporting collaborative workflows.

projects.name: Estimation - Natural Maths
projects.description: Inherited and delivered the MVP for the Natural Maths app, a standalone React application (JavaScript, CSS Modules) designed to let users enter mathematical equations in a style similar to Excel. Implemented features for inline variable creation using special commands, and focused on usability and flexibility to support complex construction estimation workflows. Continued to enhance the app post-MVP to meet evolving user needs.
